description: Na₈Mg(CoO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.39 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.53 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three CoO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.68 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.50 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.83 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.84 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.91 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.63 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MgO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.03 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra, and  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-1.98 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted CoO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid,  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-1.99 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form ONa₅Co octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₅Co octahedra, edges with four ONa₅Co octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₄MgCo pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-19°. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form ONa₅Co octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₄MgCo pentagonal pyramids and edges with four ONa₅Co octahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Co atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to four Na, one Mg, and one Co atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄MgCo pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-9°. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form distorted ONa₅Co octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₅Co octahedra, edges with four ONa₅Co octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₄MgCo pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-19°.
